pages:
Little Lumi, a firefly bright,
Flew through the forest, day and night.
Her light was small, a tiny spark,
Afraid to fly out of the dark.

She worried much, this firefly small,
"My glow is weak, I'll surely fall!"
The other bugs, they shone so bold,
Their stories brave, they all had told.

One night, she heard a whispered plea,
"Oh, help me, please, I cannot see!"
An old, lost owl, with eyes so dim,
Was stuck inside a hollow limb.

Lumi felt fear, a chilling breeze,
She knew she must, if she could, please.
But **Lumi**, our hero, felt so small,
“**My glow is weak, I'll surely fall!**”

She took a breath, a moment deep,
A coping moment, secrets to keep.
She thought of joy, of sunny days,
And focused on her inner rays.

Her little light began to grow,
A gentle beam, a steady show.
She flew toward the hollow tree,
"Don't worry, Owl, you wait for me!"

She shone her light upon the wall,
Guiding the owl, answering his call.
He blinked his eyes, no longer lost,
And thanked sweet Lumi at any cost.

"You saved my life, you tiny light,"
"You chased away the darkest night."
He hooted softly, a grateful sound,
As Lumi circled all around.

Then, a magical surprise so grand,
A shower of stars, across the land!
Each tiny star, a loving gleam,
Reflected light, a waking dream.

The owl explained, with knowing eyes,
"Your brave little heart reached to the skies!"
"Your courage true, has set us free,"
"A beacon bright, for all to see!"

Now Lumi flies, no longer shy,
Her light shines brightly in the sky.
She knows her strength, she knows her worth,
A brave little firefly, upon this Earth.
She knew she must, if she could, **please**.
